en-US.desktop.cli.title: CLI
en-US.desktop.cli.help: Register the lithe command for your default shell. This writes only the shown shell configuration or user PATH and a launcher in your user data. Registration is off by default. Use lithe <folder> to open a project, or lithe <file> for an editor with bundled highlighting and no plugins.
en-US.desktop.cli.reopenTerminal: Open a new terminal for the change to take effect.
en-US.desktop.cli.failed: Could not update CLI registration. Check the configuration permissions and refresh to try again.
en-US.desktop.cli.unsupportedShell: This default shell is not supported yet. Use zsh, bash, sh or fish, then refresh.
en-US.desktop.cli.launcherConflict: Another command already exists at the launcher path. Move it aside, then refresh and register again.
en-US.desktop.cli.conflict: The shell configuration changed. Refresh its status before applying again.
en-US.desktop.singleFile.help: Bundled syntax highlighting and text editing, with an optional terminal. Project indexing, Git and all plugins remain inactive.
en-US.desktop.singleFile.openFolderHelp: Open the containing folder in a new project window, where project services and enabled plugins become available.
en-US.desktop.cli.usage:
Usage: lithe [--] [file-or-folder]
lithe --help
lithe --version

A folder opens a project; a file opens in Single File Mode without plugins.

zh-CN.desktop.cli.title: CLI
zh-CN.desktop.cli.help: 为默认 shell 注册 lithe 命令。此操作会修改下方显示的 shell 配置或用户 PATH，并在用户数据目录创建启动器。默认不注册。lithe <文件夹> 打开项目，lithe <文件> 打开仅使用内置高亮、不激活插件的编辑器。
zh-CN.desktop.cli.failed: 无法读取或更新 CLI 注册。请检查配置文件权限，刷新状态后重试。
zh-CN.desktop.cli.unsupportedShell: 暂不支持当前默认 shell。请使用 zsh、bash、sh 或 fish，然后刷新状态。
zh-CN.desktop.cli.launcherConflict: 启动器位置已存在其他命令。请先移走该文件，再刷新并重新注册。
zh-CN.desktop.cli.conflict: shell 配置已被修改。请刷新状态后重新操作。
zh-CN.desktop.singleFile.help: 提供内置语法高亮和文本编辑，可按需打开终端。项目索引、Git 和所有插件保持关闭。
zh-CN.desktop.singleFile.openFolder: 以项目打开所在文件夹
zh-CN.desktop.singleFile.openFolderHelp: 在新项目窗口中打开所在文件夹，启用项目服务和已启用的插件。
zh-CN.desktop.cli.usage:
用法：lithe [--] [文件或文件夹]
lithe --help
lithe --version

文件夹以项目打开；文件以不激活插件的单文件模式打开。
